input.sql: SELECT v.visit_type, (v.discharge_date IS NULL) AS no_discharge_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {src}.clinic_visits v GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

input.rationale: discharge_date is only recorded for inpatient (IPD) stays; outpatient and emergency visits end on the day they start, which is the OHDSI convention when no end date is known.

final_text: The visit_occurrence insert failed because visit_end_date is required but clinic_visits.discharge_date is empty for every OPD and EMERG visit (only IPD stays have one). I changed visit_end_date to COALESCE(v.discharge_date::date, v.visit_date::date), so single-day visits end on their start date. No data-quality results were available yet because the build stopped at this error.
